svg.title: Prediction quality and comparison uncertainty
svg.desc: Panel A shows held-out Brier scores for the five fitted scoring rules. Panel B shows all four planned Brier differences and both the original evaluation-only bootstrap intervals and the post-hoc intervals that refit on resampled calibration data. Negative differences favour confidence review. The primary comparison includes zero in both analyses. The secondary benefit beyond original confidence remains below zero in both.
